Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,C.S.C.,Sanjay Kumar Om
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1.

Heard Shri Sudhir Kumar Tripathi, learned counsel for the petitioner and Shri Sanja Kumar Om,
learned counsel for the Union of India.

2.  In view of the order proposed to be passed, no notice is required to be issued to the 5th respondent.
3.
The instant writ petition is preferred inter-

alia seeking following reliefs:-
"A. Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the respondent no.3 not to release the payment of compensation/award to the Sanjay Kumar vs Union Of India And 4 Others on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110134010/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 respondent no.5 during the pendency of the case no.2032 of 2020, under section 34 of L.R. Act pending before Naib Tehsildar Nautanawa, District Maharajganj Kunserva, Tappa Marchwar, Pargana Vinaykapur, Tehsil Nautanawa, District Maharajganj of Arazai No.445, 335, 431, 432, 453.

B. Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondent no.2, District Magistrate, Maharajganj to decide the representation of the petitioner pending since 06.06.2024."
4.

Learned counsel for the petitioner states that the petitioner is also having stake in the property in dispute and the petitioner has instituted proceeding under section 34 of L.R. Act, which is pending consideration before Naib Tehsildar.

He further submits that the rights of the petitioner are yet to be crystalized by the competent court and, in case, the amount of compensation is released in favour of the 5th respondent, the petitioner would suffer irreparable loss and injury.
5. Considering the factual situation, we are not inclined to keep the matter pending consideration.

With the consent of parties, the instant writ petition is disposed off with the observation that in case,
the petitioner files an objection before the competent authority/Deputy Special Land Acquisition Officer, Maharajganj, definitely, the same would be considered in accordance with law but certainly after giving due opportunity to 5th respondent.
Order Date :- 13.9.2024 S.P.
